messages:
Oliver Tan: Hey everyone 44b First day here on Platform! A few quick setup Qs: 1) laptop preference (I work mostly in Linux, is that ok?) 2) VPN + MFA for EU remote access? 3) who to grab a badge from when I'm in SF next month? Also hello! Excited to join.

Marta (IT): Welcome Oliver 389 Linux devboxes are totally fine, especially for platform folks. If you want a Mac we can order one too. For VPN in EU we use WireGuard + Okta MFA. I'll DM the config and a WireGuard profile.

Oliver Tan: Thanks Marta. For SSH keys, do we use the GitHub UI or some internal key-manager?

Samir (People Ops): Hi Oliver 60a Badge pickup: fill out this form (https://redwood.intranet/forms/badge) and select "SF - Reception" for pickup date when you're in town. Bring a photo ID and we'll approve access.

Marta (IT): For keys: GitHub keys + internal approval flow. Create an ed25519 key and paste the pubkey at our keys page. Link: https://redwood.github.io/ssh-keys Steps:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "oliver@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy  # mac
```
Then request repo access via the internal UI.

Nia Gomez: Hey Oliver 44b I'm your buddy for the first two weeks. We usually do a 30m pairing to get local dev running and walk through the infra sandbox. Want to do that today at 4pm CET? Also fyi: weekly platform sync on Wednesdays.

Oliver Tan: 4pm CET works great. Two fun facts: I bake sourdough and I take photos of abandoned transit stations 601 Can't wait to meet the team.

Marta (IT): Ordering a Linux devbox now and sending the WireGuard profile. If you hit a permissions popup on enrollment, paste the screenshot here and I'll fix it.

BuddyBot: Oliver Tan was added to #eng-platform and #new-hires. :tada:
